question: Which canal has a head regulator capacity of 1133 cumecs (40000 cusecs) and a length of 532 km for which it is considered the world's largest lined irrigation canal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada Main Canal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Narmada Main Canal has a head regulator capacity of **1133 cumecs (40000 cusecs)**.
 
• This canal has a total length of **532 km**, making it the **world's largest lined irrigation canal**.
 
• The canal originates from the **Sardar Sarovar Dam** on the Narmada River, located in the Indian state of Gujarat.
 
• The Narmada Main Canal is designed to provide irrigation facilities and drinking water to a large region, including parts of Gujarat, Rajasthan, and even the arid regions of Kutch and Saurashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Narmada River**

 
 
• The Narmada River is the fifth-largest river in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It flows westwards over a length of 1,312 kilometers before draining into the Arabian Sea.
 
• The river is of immense significance as it serves as a major source of water for irrigation, drinking, and industrial purposes for the states it flows through.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Sarovar Dam**
 
 
• The Sardar Sarovar Dam is one of the largest and most controversial dam projects in India.
 
• It is located on the Narmada River in the state of Gujarat.
 
• The dam is designed to provide water for irrigation, drinking, and industrial purposes to several states including Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan.
 
• The dam has a height of 163 meters and a length of 1,210 meters.
 
 
 
• **Irrigation Canals**
 
 
• Irrigation canals are man-made channels that deliver water to agricultural fields.
 
• These canals are crucial for agriculture, especially in arid and semi-arid regions where rainfall is insufficient.
 
• Lined canals, like the Narmada Main Canal, are constructed with concrete or other materials to prevent water seepage and loss, ensuring efficient water delivery.
